banner.title: rsshub
banner.tagline: Turns sites without feeds into RSS, caches the results in Dragonfly, and renders browser-only pages in a Playwright Chromium.

art.about: a feed generator that turns web pages into RSS, using a cache and a headless browser for hard pages
art.title: How rsshub builds a feed

explainer.title: A feed request, a cache check, a browser when needed

steps.title: Tokens
steps.text: ExternalSecret rsshub writes rsshub-secret from item rss-hub. Its template uses the default Replace merge, so only four placeholder keys are expected.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Request
steps.text: envoy-internal forwards the feed request to the rsshub service on port 80. The /healthz probe checks the app itself.
steps.scene: a request arrow entering a gateway arch

steps.title: Cache
steps.text: CACHE_TYPE is redis, pointed at the rsshub-dragonfly cache. Dragonfly is cache-only, so a restart empties it.
steps.scene: a fast cache block with a refresh arrow

steps.title: Browse
steps.text: Routes that need a real browser call the playwright service over WebSocket on port 3000. That pod has no PVC.
steps.scene: a headless browser window rendering a page

steps.title: Feed
steps.text: The app returns RSS, Atom or JSON feeds to any reader. The app itself keeps no volume.
steps.scene: a feed card with signal waves
